The verse claims that fixing the mind at the சுழுமுனை and seeing the breath (காலை) gives காயசித்தி; it names no alternate-nostril practice and no blood-pressure effect, so the overlap is only breath-practice and body.

The verse names பாடாணம் and செந்தூரம் in the Mother's drug and says it makes the poet burn (தணலாக வேகுறண்டி); the finding documents poisoning from arsenic-containing Siddha preparations, but whether the burning is harm or mystical heat is unfixed, so the link is shared topic rather than a clear claim.
The verse traces a flame from the navel (உந்தி) to the crown and ends in the sound கீச்சுமூச்சு; it says nothing about alternate-nostril breathing or blood pressure.
text_issue: கிந்து is probably a misreading of விந்து.

reason: The verse mounts the mantra-chariot (மந்திரத்தேர்) with the five letters (ஐந்தெழுத்து) as arrow to hunt the deer; reading the deer as the restless mind needs a gloss, so it only shares the topic of mantra with the default-mode deactivation finding.

நாட்டுக்கால், நடுவுக்கால் and ஆட்டுக்கால் become ida, pingala and sushumna only by cipher; the Tamil never names breath or nostril, so it can only share the topic of the two channels with the nasal-cycle finding.
The verse says the graced are known by austerity, love and obscure speech (அருள், அன்பு, இருளுறு சொல்); it makes no claim about what loving-kindness practice does to wellbeing.
A praise of the one Substance (வஸ்து) as formless and formed; nothing about metals or transmutation.

The verse mocks those who wander after முப்பு without knowing how it came and offers சித்தி by turning back; it does not claim gold from mercury, so it shares only the alchemy topic with the transmutation finding.

The verse says those who heat சூதம் and கெந்தி in the crucible without knowledge will get no சொர்னம்; the finding concerns heavy-metal contamination of sold products, not transmutation, so only the metal-preparation topic is shared.
The verse calls the world a dream made by the inner faculties (அந்தக்கரணம், சொற்பனம்); decoherence times in neurons do not bear on that idealist claim.
The verse warns that desire for women (பெண்ணாசை) blocks desire for heaven; nasal breathing and limbic rhythms are unrelated.
The verse says பெண்ணாசை leaves no way to விண்ணாசை; both concern desire and its pursuit, but the verse makes no claim about happiness returning to a set point.
The verse is about burning the ghost-nature, entering the சுழிமுனை and subduing ஆங்காரம்; it names no breathing technique and nothing about blood pressure.
The verse describes raising a fire through the channel (நாடி) past six lotuses (ஆறுபங்கயம்); it makes no claim about one-nostril breathing or hemispheric activation.
The verse speaks of an eight-fold figure and a wheel of eights known after knowing the Lord (எம்பிரானை அறிந்தபின்); nothing about emotion as bodily prediction.
The verse reduces the Agamas to the five letters (அஞ்செழுத்து) and Sivayam; it makes no claim about brain structure in meditators.
A verse on heating சூதம் and கெந்தி for gold; sleep and glymphatic clearance are unrelated.

The verse claims a fixed quota of breaths (இருபத்தோராயிரத்தறுநூறு சுவாசம் a day) whose outflow shortens life (நாள் குறைந்து); the finding is about heart-rate variability during slow breathing, not lifespan, so it shares the breath topic without testing the quota claim.
The verse names இடை, பிங்கலை and சுழுமுனை and identifies the Lord with them; it makes no claim about airflow alternating, so it only shares the two-sided breath topic with the nasal-cycle finding.
The verse prescribes இரேசகம் by பிங்கலை, பூரகம் on the left and கும்பகம் as சிவநாட்டம்; the finding is about the spontaneous nasal cycle, which does not bear on this deliberate practice's claim.
The pearl's light in the shell (சிப்பியின் முத்தொளி) is a simile for an unseen Lord; it is not a report of perceived lights or distress in meditation, so the shared 'light' is incidental.

The verse says that blowing (ஊத) the bellows (துருத்தி) with a mind set right makes the pillar blaze into light; reading the bellows as breath is a gloss, and the claimed result (நிருத்தமான சோதி) is not what the parasympathetic finding measures.
The verse names the waking state (சாக்கிரம்) and Virat; the Diosi-Penrose collapse test is unrelated.
The verse uses sleep (நித்திரை) that makes learning and kin forgotten as a question about the self; it makes no claim about brain waste clearance, so only the sleep topic is shared.

The verse calls the mind a mad monkey (மனக்குரங்கு) to be subdued by medicine before the horse can be ridden; the finding on how often minds wander and its link to unhappiness shares the restless-mind topic but does not test the verse's claim about subduing it.
அசவை is read as the ajapa breath-mantra only by the gloss, and the verse's claim is that all is Sivayam; it says nothing about recitation slowing breath, so it shares only the mantra topic.
The verse warns against பெண்ணாசை; psilocybin treatment of depression is unrelated.
The verse says that working the வாசி by இரேசக பூரக கும்பம் is itself desire (ஆசை) to be left for non-dual Brahman; it makes no physiological claim the HRV finding could test.
The verse recounts Siva turning back so that all the poet's desire (காமம்) for the maya-woman would leave; it shares the craving topic but makes no claim about wanting versus liking.
Desire for mantras and for beauty (சுந்தரத்தி லாசை) refuse to be let go; this shares the topic of desire with hedonic adaptation but says nothing about happiness returning to a set point.
மூலநெருப்பு, நிலா மண்டபம் and பால் are a cipher of fire, moon and nectar ending hunger; nothing about where emotions are felt in the body.
The verse calls the body a water bubble (நீர்க்குமிழி) mistaken for permanent; brain structure after mindfulness training is unrelated.
The verse claims a red calcined செந்தூரம் turns the nine metals (நவலோகம்) and gives the art of வேதை; the microbial makeup of the body is unrelated.

The verse claims that reciting (செபிப்பீரேல்) the beginningless மந்திரம் makes the five great sins fly like cotton; the cortical-deactivation finding shares the recitation topic but cannot speak to sin.

The verse says that once the delusion of desire for women (வஞ்சியர் ஆசை) takes hold it does not go, and calls ஆசாபாசம் a fire; this shares the craving topic, but the finding's specific claim (wanting dissociated from liking) is not in the verse.

The verse boasts powers, making the eight nagas dance and showing Indra's world here (இந்திரனார் உலகத்தை இங்கே காட்டுவோம்); the psi replication failure concerns precognition, so it only shares the topic of claimed paranormal power.

The verse catalogues the body as a vessel of waste, humours (வாதபித்தங்கோழை) and lust (காமக் கனல்); it shares the body topic with the bodily-maps finding but makes no claim about where emotions are felt.
The verse places the letters of Om at the kundalini, nape and whirl (அகாரம், மகாரம்); heavy metals in sold products are unrelated.
